description: A React component file for the 'Draft Persona' page in a Next.js app. It handles viewing and editing a user's AI-generated professional persona, including profile photo upload, identity info, skills, summary, key experiences, and progress navigation.

methods.name: PlaceholderAvatarIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering a default avatar SVG icon.

methods.name: PencilIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering a pencil icon SVG, used to indicate avatar edit action.

methods.name: CheckIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering a checkmark SVG, used in the success toast.

methods.name: SkillChip
methods.description: A React component displaying a skill tag with optional remove button.

methods.name: TextInput
methods.description: A reusable text input with label, supporting disabled state and placeholder.

methods.name: Textarea
methods.description: A multiline text input with label, supporting disabled state and placeholder.

methods.name: ExperienceCard
methods.description: A card component for displaying and editing a key experience item.

methods.name: WorkStyleInsight
methods.description: A styled info box summarizing inferred work traits.

methods.name: SuccessToast
methods.description: A notification component shown after successful save, with dismiss button.

methods.name: makeDefaultSkillsFromPersona
methods.description: Utility to initialize skills array from persona data.

methods.name: DraftPersonaPage
methods.description: Main React component implementing the draft persona review/edit page. It manages state, avatar upload, edit mode, saving, and routing to next step.
